set.body:
Problem

ResponsePreparation currently represents fixed/estimated volume weighting but reports that the transform is deferred.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Supported fixed and estimated weighting plans are applied to both design and response through the declared square-root weighting convention.
- [ ] Weight construction rejects non-finite and negative values; zero-weight semantics and their effect on rank/df are explicit.
- [ ] Weight length, run segmentation, selected/censored rows, and response alignment are validated before factorization.
- [ ] WLS equals OLS on D X and D Y, D = diag(sqrt(w)), within condition-aware tolerances.
- [ ] Coefficients, residual variance, normalized covariance, standard errors, residual df, and contrast statistics agree with independent R lm.wfit or direct QR fixtures.
- [ ] Multiresponse WLS factors the weighted design once and agrees with independent single-response fits.
- [ ] Complete and chunked response execution are observationally equivalent.
- [ ] Preparation provenance reports weighting source, scope, normalization, excluded/zero rows, and whether weights were fixed or estimated.
- [ ] No configuration advertised as supported remains merely Deferred; unsupported estimation policies fail during planning.
- [ ] JVM and Scala.js unit, law, and scenario tests pass.
set.title: P2.4: execute fixed and estimated volume weighting with lawful WLS semantics
